title: 第10章 刘倩倩的到来第11章 女儿村的暴动
content_zh:
：“砰！”
二者刚刚接触的一瞬间便产生了巨大的爆炸！
刘倩倩身体随即倒飞了出去！
身上的黑雾逐渐消散，身上更是没有任何一处地方是完好的！
而赵中这边也不容乐观，整个人像瞬间苍老了10多岁！
身体也是直接瘫软的跪倒在地，看来刚刚的消耗对他的而言已经极大了！
见状，我立马上前搀扶着赵史，看着远处被炸飞在地的刘倩倩，我以为事情终于结束告一段落的时候。
刘倩倩身体扭曲的，慢慢从地上爬了起来，双手双脚撑地，整个身躯直接倒挂了起来，脸部全是腐烂的肉块，姿势犹如蜘蛛一般！
刘倩倩看着我怒吼道：“臭道士，现在就是你的忌日！
还有你我的夫君，我看现在谁还救得了你们！”
刘倩倩说完，身体如同蜘蛛一般诡异的向我扭曲着跑了过来，见状我已绝望的闭上双眼。
过了许久，并没有和我预想的一样，刘倩倩并没有立马来到我身旁，对我张开血盆大口咬掉我的脑。
我缓缓的睁开双眼只见，可并不是我想的那样，应接我的死亡并没有出现。
相反反而映入我眼前的是一个绝美的身影，脸上挂着自信从容不迫的笑容，和那乌黑飘逸的头发。
那不正是我消失多年的女朋友刘倩倩吗？他怎么突然出现在这里了？莫非又是一具干尸所变？
此时无数的问题在我脑子里面疯狂浮现，而关于我和刘倩倩的一幕幕的回忆，在我脑海里面不停播放。
可来不及我多想，只见刘倩倩从挎包里掏出皱黄色的符咒，喃喃道：“雷祖圣帝，远处天曹，掌管神将，邓辛张陶，能警万恶，不赦魔妖，雷声一震，万劫全销.急急如律令！”
符咒瞬间燃烧开了，化作一道的细微的闪电，径直的劈向了眼前的女鬼！
女鬼本就已经被赵史的符咒击中元气大伤，面对突如其来的刘倩倩的攻击，来不及过多反应，身体瞬间倒飞了出去！
一道道雷光劈打在女鬼的身上，女鬼腐烂的身躯瞬间被雷电劈的焦黑！

散发出阵阵恶臭，令人恶心至极。
“你到底是谁？”
我一脸不可置信的盯着我面前消失了多年的女友陈倩倩。
她的出现让我心里里五味杂粮，正是因为她的出现，才改变了我！
也才会让我三叔而死！
刘倩倩回过头来，一脸淡漠的看着我，沉默了良久，绝美而精致的面容传来声音道：“我还能是谁，我是刘倩倩，你消失多年的女友。”
我听了之后，顿时怒气涌上心尖！
一把抓住了刘倩倩的衣领厉声怒吼：“都是因为你！
破坏了我原本的人生！
要不是当初你突然不辞而别！
突然发短信骗我去什么乱葬岗！
我三叔怎么会死？你为什么又要突然回来！
你到底是谁！”
此时这几天长久以来，积蓄的所有情绪在这一瞬间爆发了出来！
content_en:
: "Bang!"
The moment the two came into contact, a huge explosion occurred!
Liu Qianqian's body immediately flew out!
The black mist on the body gradually dissipated, and no part of the body was intact!
Zhao Zhong is not optimistic either. His whole portrait instantly aged by more than 10 years!
His body also fell to his knees limply. It seemed that the consumption just now was already too great for him!
Upon seeing this, I immediately stepped forward to help Zhao Shi. Looking at Liu Qianqian who was blown to the ground in the distance, I thought the matter was finally over.
Liu Qianqian's body was twisted, and she slowly got up from the ground. She put her hands and feet on the ground, and her whole body hung upside down. Her face was covered with rotten flesh, and her posture was like a spider!
Liu Qianqian looked at me and roared: "Smelly Taoist priest, now is the anniversary of your death!
And you and my husband, I wonder who can save you now! "
After Liu Qianqian finished speaking, her body twisted weirdly like a spider and ran towards me. Seeing this, I closed my eyes in despair.
After a long time, as I expected, Liu Qianqian did not come to me immediately, open her bloody mouth to me and bite off my brain.
I slowly opened my eyes and saw that it was not what I thought. Death did not appear to meet me.
On the contrary, what came into my eyes was a beautiful figure with a confident and unhurried smile on her face, and her black flowing hair.
Isn’t that my girlfriend Liu Qianqian who has disappeared for many years? Why did he suddenly appear here? Could it be another mummy?
At this time, countless questions were popping up in my mind crazily, and memories of scenes between me and Liu Qianqian kept playing in my mind.
But before I could think too much, I saw Liu Qianqian taking out a wrinkled yellow talisman from her shoulder bag and murmuring: "The Holy Emperor Leizu, the Heavenly Cao from afar, is in charge of the divine generals, Deng Xin and Zhang Tao, who can warn against all evils and not forgive demons. With a thunder, all calamities will be wiped out. Urgency is like a law and order!"
The talisman burned instantly and turned into a tiny bolt of lightning, striking straight at the female ghost in front of him!
The female ghost had already been seriously injured by Zhao Shi's spell. Faced with Liu Qianqian's sudden attack, she had no time to react and her body flew backwards in an instant!
Rays of lightning struck the female ghost's body, and the female ghost's rotting body was instantly scorched black by the lightning!
It gave off a stench that was extremely disgusting.
"Who are you anyway?"
I stared in disbelief at my girlfriend Chen Qianqian who had disappeared for many years.
Her appearance made me feel mixed with emotions. It was precisely because of her appearance that I changed!
That’s why I let my third uncle die!
Liu Qianqian turned around and looked at me indifferently. After a long silence, a voice came from her beautiful and delicate face: "Who else could I be? I am Liu Qianqian, your girlfriend who has disappeared for many years."
After I heard this, anger suddenly welled up in my heart!
He grabbed Liu Qianqian’s collar and shouted angrily: “It’s all because of you!
It ruined my original life!
If you hadn't left suddenly without saying goodbye!
Suddenly he sent me a text message to trick me into going to some mass grave!
How could my third uncle die? Why do you have to come back suddenly!
Who are you? "
At this moment, all the emotions accumulated over the past few days burst out at this moment!
